notes: These are inventory-backed qualification candidates, not ten proven poor-website leads. Every record has an independent website; a concrete website opportunity must be established before building.
RetrievedAt is our retrieval date, not a promise of a live origin response. The research service may return crawled pages. Material age/conflicts are recorded below.
Result totals may include sold vehicles or other categories. Confirm available-only filters and unique passenger-car/truck stock; never sum duplicate inventory across platforms.
Using a common dealer-site vendor, showing request-price inventory, or having a large stock count is not by itself a website defect. Opportunity hypotheses are not measured conversion findings.
ExistingClientPath null means no corresponding project was matched in the inspected Cars client tree, not proof that no other workspace, CRM or prior sales contact exists.

leads.name: Texas Drive Auto
leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved catalogue reports 58 results. The dealer describes itself as cash-only; finance functionality must not be inherited from a template as a claimed service.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Compact available-stock discovery and clear cash-price, vehicle-detail and viewing-enquiry presentation, subject to a current mobile audit.
leads.nextAction: Audit the owned website, confirm current cash-only policy and active stock, and identify a specific improvement before authorizing three concepts.

leads.name: CFO Auto Group
leads.evidenceNote: The inventory page reports 57 available vehicles. Extracted homepage copy contains repeated purchasing/test-drive sections; responsive markup could explain this, so a visible repetition defect is not established.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A shorter stock-first journey and consistent vehicle enquiry presentation, with language needs confirmed rather than assumed.
leads.nextAction: Inspect mobile and desktop rendered pages, verify any repetition and the actual customer languages, then decide whether the three templates offer a meaningful improvement.

leads.name: Neuhoff Auto Sales

inventory.caveat: Sum of the retrieved homepage's make counts, not an independently counted live available inventory. A separately retrieved older inventory snapshot showed 77; refresh both before use.

leads.evidenceNote: Homepage make totals sum to 74. The extracted Sunday-hours value appears incomplete. Both the public hours and count discrepancy need current verification, not speculative correction.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A coherent current-stock catalogue with verified hours and straightforward vehicle appointments; audit against the existing site's actual capabilities.
leads.nextAction: Refresh the stock totals and business hours, capture the mobile inventory/detail journey and qualify only with a demonstrable website opportunity.

leads.name: AMT AUTO SALES LLC

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled last week.

leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved catalogue shows 80 results, real vehicle details and price reductions. This establishes catalogue scale, not poor design or misleading pricing.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Assess clearer mobile stock comparison and transparent current-price presentation while retaining verified pricing conditions.
leads.nextAction: Verify available-only stock and actual pricing conditions, then audit mobile filters and enquiry context before preparing concepts.

leads.name: Keen Auto Mall

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final opened source was labeled crawled 1.1 years ago.
inventory.caveat: The opened page showed 73 results while another search snapshot showed 100. Neither is accepted as current stock; this lead is held for refresh.

leads.evidenceNote: The accessible historical page contains a substantial catalogue and request-price entries, but conflicting/stale snapshots prevent current inventory qualification.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Potential branded stock and pricing-enquiry improvements, only after current business activity and website state are confirmed.
leads.nextAction: Refresh the live dealership and available inventory first. Do not build or describe this as a verified 100-car current prospect from the search snippet.

leads.name: Depue Auto Sales Inc

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled yesterday.

leads.evidenceNote: The catalogue reports 100 results and already provides filters, prices and vehicle enquiry links. Their presence must be acknowledged when comparing a proposed design.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Test whether a more compact mobile catalogue, consistent specifications and dealer presentation improve the existing browsing journey.
leads.nextAction: Verify unique available inventory and record a concrete mobile/task-based gap. A vendor-template look alone does not qualify the lead.

leads.name: MY CAR OUTLET

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled last week.

leads.evidenceNote: 80 retrieved catalogue results, with prices and vehicle-level enquiries already present. The website's visual usability was not tested.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A compact value-car catalogue and clearer model/condition comparison, if a direct audit shows room for improvement.
leads.nextAction: Check current inventory and customer purchase journeys, then compare the same sample cars across the three existing template designs.

leads.name: Good Wheels Auto Sales, Inc

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled two weeks ago.
inventory.caveat: An earlier search snapshot showed 100; use 99 only as the final retrieved page total, not a live availability guarantee.

leads.evidenceNote: The retrieved page reports 99 results and repeatedly asks visitors to email for a price. That may be intentional policy, not a bug; ownership of the policy needs confirmation.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A clear request-price or verified-price experience that keeps the selected vehicle attached to the enquiry.
leads.nextAction: Verify current stock and pricing policy, then inspect the full enquiry journey without sending a test message to the business.

leads.name: Sevierville Import & Truck Center

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled last month.
inventory.caveat: Navigation includes motorcycles, RVs, boats and heavy equipment; confirm how many of the 107 results are relevant available cars/trucks. An earlier search snapshot showed 100.

leads.evidenceNote: 107 results appear in the retrieved catalogue. Virtual appointments and video walkarounds are already advertised, so these cannot be pitched as absent features.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: Clearer stock segmentation and vehicle-specific enquiries across the relevant cars/trucks, subject to template fit.
leads.nextAction: Count the relevant available cars/trucks separately and check that the three car templates fit before qualifying this mixed-inventory business.

leads.name: Nicky D's

inventory.sourceFreshness: The final retrieved source was labeled crawled four days ago.
inventory.caveat: An earlier search snapshot showed 80; 82 is the final opened page's result count.

leads.evidenceNote: 82 retrieved results and an existing priced/filterable catalogue. No measured website weakness or willingness to replace its current provider was established.
leads.opportunityHypothesis: A more distinctive dealer identity and compact mobile browsing, only if comparison with the current site demonstrates a useful benefit.
leads.nextAction: Verify stock freshness, audit the live mobile/detail/contact journey and research the business decision path before spending on speculative concepts.
